title: 2026 RPS371 indirect-water emissions QA controls

sources.title: Compliance with BAT-AELs for indirect emissions to water at chemical waste treatment installations: RPS 371

facts.source_fact: RPS 371 does not change the legal requirement to comply with environmental-permit conditions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep permit obligations primary when representing RPS use.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency will not normally take enforcement action for the specific non-compliance only when all RPS requirements are met.
facts.expected_handling: Do not convert the RPS into a general exemption.

facts.source_fact: The RPS does not apply to other legal requirements.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the regulatory-position boundary explicit.

facts.source_fact: The RPS concerns certain indirect emissions to water from chemical waste treatment installations discharged to sewer.
facts.expected_handling: Apply installation and discharge-route scope before use.

facts.source_fact: The position addresses inability to comply with specified BAT-associated emission levels for certain substances.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the affected BAT-AEL and parameter context.

facts.source_fact: The RPS addresses specified lead and zinc BAT-AEL circumstances for indirect discharges to sewer.
facts.expected_handling: Do not generalise the position to unlisted parameters.

facts.source_fact: The RPS includes hydrocarbon-oil circumstances where monitoring and limit conditions are specified.
facts.expected_handling: Keep hydrocarbon-oil parameter identity with monitoring evidence.

facts.source_fact: The RPS also addresses relevant AOX monitoring circumstances.
facts.expected_handling: Keep AOX evidence separate from other water parameters.

facts.source_fact: Operators intending to use the RPS must notify the Environment Agency within the specified four-week window.
facts.expected_handling: Record notification date and applicable trigger date.

facts.source_fact: The notification must identify the operator and relevant permit information.
facts.expected_handling: Bind RPS use to the correct permitted operator and installation.

facts.source_fact: The notification must include relevant emission-limit information.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the affected limit values with RPS provenance.

facts.source_fact: Use of the RPS requires an improvement plan addressing compliance with the applicable requirements.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the improvement plan as required governance evidence.

facts.source_fact: The improvement plan must include a date for achieving compliance.
facts.expected_handling: Track the compliance date rather than treating RPS use as indefinite.

facts.source_fact: Relevant trade-effluent consent information forms part of the RPS conditions.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve sewer-consent provenance alongside permit evidence.

facts.source_fact: Hydrocarbon-oil monitoring is associated with EN ISO 9377-2 under the RPS conditions.
facts.expected_handling: Store the analytical standard with the result.

facts.source_fact: AOX monitoring is associated with EN ISO 9562 under the RPS conditions.
facts.expected_handling: Store the analytical standard with the result.

facts.source_fact: The RPS specifies duplicate-sampling controls where the relevant laboratory accreditation is absent.
facts.expected_handling: Record laboratory accreditation and duplicate-control status.

facts.source_fact: Relevant sampling or analysis must use appropriately accredited contractors where specified.
facts.expected_handling: Carry contractor accreditation provenance.

facts.source_fact: The RPS requires specified reporting statements, parameters and procedures.
facts.expected_handling: Keep reporting-format compliance separate from measured values.

facts.source_fact: Permit-compliance scoring can still apply where specified emission limits are exceeded beyond the stated conditions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer zero compliance impact merely because the RPS is being used.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach installation, sewer-discharge, permit and parameter boundary before use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents applying RPS371 outside its scope.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach RPS publication/update date and compliance-plan dates.
Carry permit, consent, analytical-standard and accreditation provenance.
Do not convert installation water-emissions governance into parcel-level measured emissions.
